mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications ( notification_id, user_id, type, message, related_id, is_read, created_time ) VALUES ( notifications_seq.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, #{type}, #{message}, #{relatedId}, #{isRead}, #{createdTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT notification_id, user_id, type, message, related_id, is_read, created_time FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_time DESC
